headline: FARMS links source-contextual Lean statements to bounded numerical skills
summary: FARMS is an author-reported pipeline that links mathematical source context and computational meaning to Lean statements, then uses semantic review, bounded repair and abstention alongside compilation. In 171 selected randomized-linear-algebra and numerical-PDE targets, the authors report 157 accepted outcomes, including three with source warnings. Two small numerical applications use selected statements in heat-flow solving and wave-response compression. A six-target comparison reports lower per-target costs than the authors’ statement-level AutoformBot adaptation, but that comparison allowed sorry for target and auxiliary proofs and is restricted to this configuration. The paper does not establish independent replication, broad domain transfer, proof-complete corpus coverage or automated discovery of new methods.
